Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 #
 ×
 @
 
 

 Meaning
 Son
 Sister
 Wife
 Father
 
 

 

Given: ‘M # N @ L × P + T

It means: M is the sister of N, N is the father of L, L is the wife of P and P is the son of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57144447f82198e48d2701f6ccdc6ca1d41a5f9e318cde5fd3b613416005f5d4.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f55e0a3eb3d14cd0e9b3c456d8f654af5f2cd969ec508b1d6c5c5d3b9b4a79e8.png] 

S, M is the **'****Son’s wife’s father’s sister'** of T.

Hence, the correct answer is "Son’s wife’s father’s sister".
